items.q: How many career episodes does a CDR need?
items.a: A CDR contains three career episodes, each describing a different period or project from your engineering work.

Engineers whose qualification is not assessed under the Washington, Sydney or Dublin Accords usually need one, as do engineers seeking chartered status or register entry where a competency report is required.

items.q: What do I need to provide?
items.a: Your résumé, project details, responsibilities and qualifications. We ask follow-up questions so the report reflects your real work.
